notes.title: All Holiday Skins Unlocked for All Players!
notes.content: All the holiday skins are now instantly available for all players! This change was made to improve personalization options right out the gate.

notes.title: NEW Monthly "Holiday" Customization!
notes.content:
[b]Added 12 new monthly "holiday" customization options![/b] All you have to do is play the game and you will immediately unlock the customization associated with the current month. Below is the list of new customization options:

[list]
[*] January: [b]New Years[/b]
[*] February: [b]Valentine's Day[/b]
[*] March: [b]St. Patrick's Day[/b]
[*] April: [b]Easter[/b]
[*] May: [b]Cinco De Mayo[/b]
[*] June: [b]Summer Solstice[/b]
[*] July: [b]4th of July[/b]
[*] August: [b]Back to School[/b]
[*] September: [b]Oktoberfest[/b]
[*] October: [b]Halloween[/b]
[*] November: [b]Thanksgiving[/b]
[*] December: [b]Christmas[/b]
[/list]
